newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer receives tenders for notes.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer receives tenders for notes.

text.p: Pioneer Cos Inc said that its subsidiary, Pioneer Americas Acquisition Corp, had received tenders for substantially all of its outstanding 13-3/8 percent First Mortgage Notes due 2005.

The consent solicitation expired on June 3 at 1700 EDT. In addition, the company announced that it is offering to pay the previously announced consent fee of $30 per $1,000 principal amount for any and all of the remaining First Mortgage Notes tendered by 12:00 EDT on June 5.
The tender offer expires at midnight EDT on June 16.
